scope: Private UTC-day counts since this release; no backfill or unique-visitor estimate. Live means server configuration, not verified human/attendee activity. Client reports are best effort and deduplicated per author/card/action. Counts expire after thirty days.
interpretation: PNG requested does not prove a file was saved. Native-share resolved does not prove recipient delivery. Completion timing includes moderation and is not end-to-end phone latency. Cohorts can span days, so these counts are not a conversion-rate denominator.
